papers.title: Geometry-Aware Hyperbolic Residual-Quantized Variational Autoencoders

papers.title: What Makes a Good Semantic ID for Generative Recommendation? A Reproducibility Study

papers.label: UNIQUE

papers.title: Addressing Cross-Stage Decoupling of Semantic and Collaborative Signals in Generative Recommendation

papers.summary: HypRQ-VAE在双曲空间递归量化残差，适应长尾层级结构，归入码本表达增强。

papers.summary: Tlow用可逆流变换减少维度相关和尺度不均，再独立子空间量化，支撑并行预测。
